BiblicalUsage: Shinab is the king of Admah who goes out with the kings of the plain against Chedorlaomer. He fights in the battle where Abram rescues Lot.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a king of Admah is worth naming because Abram's rescue is told king by king, and Shinab is one of them.
